HF18.3 fixes launcher StrictMode/ShowDialog crashes, adds guarded event recovery, uses a vector ELYSIUM badge, and prevents stale unmarked Lucid preferences from silently replacing the freshly installed ELYSIUM runtime/deck. Only explicit current UserSelected=1 choices preserve Lucid.

The exact package passed build/package/Windows/WARP/launcher-smoke/hash/Defender validation with 0 Defender detections. Real-game behavior remains title/GPU/driver specific.
